still_wrong.title: bringBack pulls a sheet back almost at once, so the user cannot scroll a panel to look at anything else during a step

The ledger says 1.2 s. The content moving by itself right after the finger lifts can also read as the jiggle the user reported.
still_wrong.fix: Wait longer (1.5 to 2 s after the last scroll, and only once no finger is down), or bring back only the chain bar and only when the lit part is the task's target, or show a small 'back to the step' hint instead of scrolling.

still_wrong.title: Test only: per-frame readers still read false offsets where something paints over the target (open in the ledger)

still_wrong.fix: Read only edges with no other element painted over them (elementsFromPoint along the edge), or compare against the target's getBoundingClientRect mapped to the frame instead of its painted outline.
